goal.current_capability: No complete label create/read API exists.
goal.required_capability: Create and read labels end-to-end through the API.

fixed_interfaces: Create returns an identity that read can consume.
state_semantics: A successfully created label remains readable by its returned identity.
protected_boundaries: CLIENT requirements cannot be redefined by implementation.

charter_invalidation_events: Physical evidence falsifies the capability boundary.
done_when: Create/read works on the exact candidate.
Independent review is bound to the exact candidate.
